typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		client_nbr as string,
		ProductTypeCode as string,
		SuperProductCode as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		branch_cd as string,
		REMAINING_AMT as decimal(15,2),
		REMAINING_QTY as decimal(17,5),
		account_cd as string,
		Settlement_Dt as timestamp,
		TAG_DT as timestamp,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as integer,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(DateYear = left(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE), 4),
		DateMonth = substring(toString(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE)), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)),
		DateDay = right(toString(EFFECTIVEDATE), 2)) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 derive(effectiveDateDerived = toDate(toString((toString(DateYear) + '-' + toString(DateMonth) + '-' + toString(DateDay)), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DerivedColumn11
DerivedColumn11 derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 derive({Copy of REMAINING_QTY} = REMAINING_QTY,
		{Copy of branch_cd} = branch_cd,
		{Copy of client_nbr} = client_nbr,
		{Copy of SuperProductCode} = SuperProductCode,
		{Copy of effectiveDateDerived} = effectiveDateDerived,
		{Copy of TAG_DT} = TAG_DT,
		{Copy of Settlement_Dt} = Settlement_Dt,
		{Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR} = TAG_CAGE_NBR,
		{Copy of REMAINING_AMT} = REMAINING_AMT,
		{Copy of account_cd} = account_cd,
		{Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR} = TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR} = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		{Copy of ProductTypeCode} = ProductTypeCode) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		settlementDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		tagDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		remainingAmt as integer,
		clientNbr as string,
		accountCd as string,
		tagCageNbr as string,
		tagDplctNbr as integer,
		superProductCode as string,
		remainingQty as integer,
		securityAdpNbr as string,
		effectiveDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		productTypeCode as string,
		branchCd as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		settlementDate = {Copy of Settlement_Dt},
		tagDate = {Copy of TAG_DT},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		remainingAmt = {Copy of REMAINING_AMT},
		clientNbr = {Copy of client_nbr},
		accountCd = {Copy of account_cd},
		tagCageNbr = {Copy of TAG_CAGE_NBR},
		tagDplctNbr = {Copy of TAG_DPLCT_NBR},
		superProductCode = {Copy of SuperProductCode},
		remainingQty = {Copy of REMAINING_QTY},
		securityAdpNbr = {Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR},
		effectiveDate = {Copy of effectiveDateDerived},
		productTypeCode = {Copy of ProductTypeCode},
		branchCd = {Copy of branch_cd}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
